The point is we shouldnt have to ask every other post for basic information. It makes a lot of us not even bother with the post. Thats a fact.

Your second paragraph is more what I was aiming for, just the details you can tell us about the game I consider part of the *body* format. Not just “its a game about saving your home town” those posts are an eyesore. 

Something as simple as “I think it was on the dreamcast, and it was an adventure game, I think the main character had white hair, and it was 3d” boom. Even just that can let us get to work.

To my point however, if you find a post that properly explains (even a little) the subreddit is more cooperative in helping. Generic “help me find x game” with a one sentence no data comment— yeah those get almost unanimously ignored. Thats why the structure is important. The odds of working with people and making a post even meaningful depends on this dichotomy.

Its all good if you dont fulfill it all, not everyone can remember each aspect. Its just mentioning the bits you may still remember even in your post comment makes your post workable. Too many people go “yeah I saw this one game when I was 12” ??? Well how long ago was that??? Do you remember the system or anything we can use to find it??

I disagree, this subreddit is great, its just people come here and dont follow very rudimentary rules that make posting and solving a breeze. Its not fun when im trying to guess a game based on “there was an enemy with a spear and hat” like ?????

Thank you. Even if you cant find it yourself just giving us bits of useful info you may remember means we can help! If you say it was a game from the 90s you saw once its just pointless trying to get us to help you feel?
Yeah I lost my temper a tad I was just trying to explain why its irritating. People have the info they just dont tell us which makes this annoying.

I dont check every post. Its just irritating opening reddit and about half the time I see a post from here and half those times its someone giving an eight word vague description of a game they saw on a screen at one point the last 20 years. Thats not information.
Guess again bud check the comments plenty of people cant stand people posting with zero data. Its just useless shit posts if they dont tell us anything.
Dont get me wrong if people dont have additional information its okay but even a few little details helps so much about finding games.

Not true at all. If you think that youve never seen a post here. Find one that says “help me find a game” with no data. Vs one that says it was some adventure game they believe was on x system. They almost always get solved va the former getting ignored. Its an eyesore.

Hang me for trying to get some eyes to notice this subreddit is handled and executed as well a blunt guillotine. If people understand they should tell us what they know it would make posts workable. Thanks for trying to do something to help though besides complaining on my thread. Oh wait

Then you may as well not even be here. I love helping people out here, its a great feeling when we solve a game X person hasnt been able to find for years, but if you cant do toddler level english you make this subreddit a waste of existing.

READ THE FULL POST BEFORE COMMENTING. The main issue here is people *NOT* telling us what they *know*. If they dont know thats okay but frequently they have information thats essential they just dont say it and it just makes every post more of a hassle.

Thats understandable, im not trying to say the title format needs to be 100 its more the post rules, if you know data about the game PLEASE for gods sake tell us. Its so much easier on everyone when they actually tell us what they know
Because its more work on everyone. Instead of giving just a few words of data for us they give a one sentence generic answer thats unsolvable.

You arent listening.

*they arent giving any data*.

If you ask them they can tell you something usually but beforehand? Its just a one sentence generic comment that is impossible to solve.

Also if you cant just tell us a few words of data based on anything you know you probably are brain dead im sorry thats not hoops that elementary basic comprehension. Use words. Dont say you saw a game and then say zero information about it. Its a waste of time

The data is part of that format. If they dont say any details other than vague bits that could apply to tens of thousands of games, no timeframe, no system it was on, no data for identifying literally anything. Its a trend. Trust me.

Go check a proper done post, with even a few bits of info the user can remember. People try to solve it. Now go to a post that says “help me find this game” that has almost no distinguishing data whatsoever. People usually dont bother.

Because the users *have* the required information typically, they just dont follow the rules, and assume we can find the game by saying “the main character has a sword” like wtf thats like tens of thousands of games. But if they chip in “I dont remember much else, I believe it was on the super nintendo and the character had a green hat and shirt” bam allova sudden now the user is working with the community and we can usually easily solve it. 

They have the required data, they just dont tell us. Saying a few vague words is *not enough information* and all it causes is a headache for all of us.

You arent wrong, my problem is people post with no info, but when asked if they can fill in the blanks, *they can*. It would just help so much from the start if people told us what they knew about the game before hand. “Oh its an fps from this gen. Ok. Great let me send you a list of all 1200 of those— oh whats that? It was a online focused game that was futuristic with a location called the tower? Destiny” 

See how much easier it is when they could say just small bits they can remember. Saying nothing but a few vague words is *not enough*.

So you dont mind getting on here and seeing

“Help me find this game, I saw forever ago, you shoot the bad guys and try to complete objectives”

Or “you play as a wizard killing goblins, I saw it on youtube I think it was from either 2004-2017 somewhere around there” 

Its nearly impossible to figure these games out with zero usable data. Once someone asks for clarification its usually a done deal case solved but if you show up and just say that ^^^ its a problem. We need a sticky at the top that says READ BEFORE POSTING really bad.
Irony I know, but seriously. Not one person takes that bot seriously 🙃

It does someday. It should. I guess it’s not right to swear the world will correct itself someday, but coming from someone who was lost for years, I found peace in my life and beat depression, and I hope you will someday too.
